description_en: Retrieves the dialog content for a call by using its call ID. You can retrieve content for calls completed within the last 30 days
description_zh: 通过CallId查询对话内容，只支持查询近一个月通话已结束的通话对话内容
name: GetCallDialogContent

parameters.description_en: The outbound call date, in yyyy-MM-dd format. You can only query data from the last 30 days.
parameters.description_zh: 外呼日期，只可查询最近30天的日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd。
parameters.help_en: The outbound call date, in yyyy-MM-dd format. You can only query data from the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 外呼日期，只可查询最近30天的日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: call_date

parameters.description_en:
The unique identifier for a call.

> The LlmSmartCall API returns this ID in the CallId parameter of its response.
